name: Витрина «За Энериум»: пятеро «Снявших Обод» — донатный сет цикла IV (ADR-0021, ADR-0022, ADR-0023, п. 9–10). Безликие — без лица: лица нет, стёрлось; облик — одежда, силуэт, приметы ремесла. Рецепт сетов II–III (jobs/donat-showcase.json, jobs/donat-set3.json): тот же стиль, три референса стиля, глубокий промт персонажа, кадр героя по пояс, корпус вправо, камера чуть снизу, зелёный песок времени с краёв плаща. Рамка усилена по правкам сетов II–III (jobs/donat-edit.json, donat-edit-2.json): модель рисовала бледную личину с тенями глаз — теперь прямо «глубокая тьма, как ночное небо, без поверхности, без маски, без глазниц»; капюшоны без звериных голов; нижний край режет фигуру по поясу, низ без плашки. Место — гавань Лайтен-Гарда (свод: белый камень, красная черепица, каскады, арки Паладиума с синим камнем в замке свода, кипарисы на верхних ярусах; скреплённые носят обод — паладиумовое ядро в энериумной оправе; четыре узкие двери наверх). Свет — синий Паладиума (вода) и зелёный Энериума. Источники: docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, сет IV; главы — design/ui/roster.js, c4-59…c4-63. У всех пятерых — бледная полоса на запястье, где был обод (главы Марты и Тэйнэ; для остальных — решение агента)
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, precious, regal: rich materials — old gold, dark bronze, black stone, deep green velvet. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold green light of time-crystals against warm gold. Fine sand and dust motes float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no name plate, no dark band at the bottom, no gems or badges of rank. No face: no pale face-like surface, no smooth mask, no eye holes, no eyes inside the hood or head-covering. No animal head on a hood. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin, not a statue.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view: the bottom edge of the picture cuts the body at the belt or the hips; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they were; the pose carries weight and intent. The head in the upper third; the lower part of the picture sinks gradually into deeper shadow — no band, no plate, nothing written. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below; rim light separates the figure from the background.

This hero is one of the Faceless: a soul of the distant past whose face has long been worn away, and who does not remember who they were. Where the face should be, inside the hood or head-covering, there is only a smooth, soft, deep darkness, as dark as a night sky — no pale surface, no smooth mask, no eye holes, no eyes, no glowing eyes, no nose, no mouth, no skull, no features at all in that darkness; the face is rubbed away like the face of an old coin. Everything else about the hero is vivid and specific: the clothing, the silhouette, the tools of the trade and above all the hands — alive, strong and expressive; the hands and the trade tell who they were. Fine green sand of time drifts from the edges of the cloak and from the fingertips and floats upward — the mark of the timeless. The rarity is the highest in the game: the portrait feels precious and regal, with old gold highlights and deep green light.

These Faceless were once bound debtors of the great harbor city of the west — a city of white stone and red roofs built in terraces where a great river breaks into branches and falls to the sea; stone arches over its canals carry glowing blue stones in their keystones, and cypresses grow on its upper tiers. A bound debtor wore a bracelet: a core of blue stone set in a band of pale green stone. These five took it off, each through one of the narrow doors out of debt, and a pale band of skin remains on the wrist where it was. Light of this set: blue light of the water rising from below, the green sand of time and old gold.

jobs.title: Тибо Выкупленный — Безликий, фармер, донатный сет IV «Снявшие Обод», 1-й (c4-59)
jobs.source: Главы c4-59: «Незнакомец в плаще» (серый плащ, мокрый у подола, спина уходит через рынок; не догнал), «Каждый порт» (в каждом порту за кого-то платил; звон, с каким снимают браслет с чужой руки; в кошеле всегда ровно на обратную дорогу), «Один за одного» (тридцать седьмой; «никому, отдай следующему»). Решение агента: поднимает вправо только что снятый с чужой руки обод, свет его ядра гаснет; кошель монет летит вправо; далеко через рынок уходит фигура в сером плаще. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-59.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Thibault the Redeemed, a man of the great harbor city, one of the Faceless. Who he is: at sixteen he was a bound debtor with a bracelet on his wrist, and a stranger in a grey cloak paid his debt and walked away across the market without giving a name; he ran after him and did not catch him. All his life he looked for the one to repay: in every port where the galleys of his harbor stood, he paid the debt of someone else. The thirty-seventh asked him whom he owed now, and he answered: no one — pass it on. Right now he has just freed a stranger's wrist and holds up the opened bracelet. Character: generous, restless and quietly determined — a man who pays it forward; his shoulders open, his movement quick and certain. Pose, the moment of the redemption: the camera is low; he stands on a quay beside a galley, turned toward the right. He has exactly two arms: his near hand holds up toward the right an opened debtor's bracelet — a heavy band of pale green stone with a blue stone core whose light is going out; his far hand tosses a small leather purse toward the right, a few gold coins spinning out and flashing. Details that tell his story: (1) a deep hood of worn grey-blue wool frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) a pale band of skin on his own wrist where his bracelet once was; (3) a long sailor's coat, salt-stained, with brass buttons; (4) a sea-bag slung over his shoulder; (5) far away across the market behind him, in soft focus, a figure in a grey cloak walks away. Place: a harbor quay at dusk: galleys with oars, crates and ropes, the white-stone city rising in terraces of red roofs, canals under arches with glowing blue keystones. Blue light rises from the water below; green time-sand drifts at his feet.

jobs.title: Марта Большой Обод — Безликая, контроль (на контроль), Вода, донатный сет IV «Снявшие Обод», 2-я (c4-60)
jobs.source: Главы c4-60: «Тяжесть на запястье» (кольцо тяжёлое, старое, тёплое от кожи, с синим камнем, который смотрел, как глаз; руку никогда не поднимала выше плеча), «Полдня тишины» (гавань замолчала; чайки кричали за всех), «Порт встал сам» (бочки остановились у сходней без приказа; бледная полоса на запястье, которую носила открыто). Решение агента: контроль — впервые поднимает левую руку выше плеча, волны синего света держат всё за правым краем в неподвижности; в дальней руке — сам тяжёлый обод, открытый. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-60.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Marta Great-Bracelet, a woman of the great harbor city, one of the Faceless, a controller of the Water school. Who she is: she was born among the bound debtors and wore an inherited bracelet from the age of seven — heavy and old, warm from the skin, with a blue stone that watched her like an eye; she never raised that hand above her shoulder. She became the elected forewoman of the harbor gangs and won them half a day of rest, and for the first time in a hundred years the port stood silent for half a day. On her last day the barrels stopped at the gangways one after another without any order: the port stood still by itself, for her. Right now she raises her hand, and everything stops. Character: commanding, calm and proud — a woman a whole harbor obeys; her back straight, her raised arm unwavering. Pose, the moment of command: the camera is low; she stands on the quay, turned toward the right. She has exactly two arms: her near arm is raised high above her shoulder, the palm open toward the right, and waves of blue light of the Water school roll from it and bind everything beyond the right edge in stillness; a pale band of skin shows around that wrist; her far hand holds the heavy old bracelet itself, opened, its blue stone still faintly glowing. Details that tell her story: (1) a long shawl of dark blue wool drawn over her head frames the smooth darkness where her face should be; (2) the pale band on her wrist, worn openly; (3) a long dark coat of a forewoman over a worker's dress, the sleeves rolled up; (4) barrels and sacks standing still on the quay behind her; (5) gulls hanging in the air. Place: the great harbor at dusk, silent: ships, gangways and cranes, the white-stone city rising above, arches over the canals with glowing blue keystones. Blue light rises from the water below; green time-sand drifts at her feet.

jobs.title: Йорен Сорок Зим — Безликий, контроль (на дебаффы), Вода, донатный сет IV «Снявшие Обод», 3-й (c4-61)
jobs.source: Главы c4-61: «Синий камень» (светился ровно, как вода под аркой ночью; считал зимы по тому, как он светит), «Так не бывает» (серое на руке, где было синее; «свободен» и «так не бывает» — оба записаны; ходил в мастерскую при храме — понял воду, камень — нет), «Арка над каналом» (синий камень в замке свода живой, светится). Решение агента: ослабление — поднимает прадедов обод с погасшим серым камнем, из него течёт холодная серо-синяя мгла, выпивающая цвет и силу врага; над ним — живой синий камень в замке арки. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-61.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Joren Forty-Winters, a man of the great harbor city, one of the Faceless, a controller of the Water school who weakens his foes. Who he is: for forty winters he lived by the water with his great-grandfather's bracelet, heavy and old, and counted the winters by how its blue stone glowed. One morning the stone went grey by itself: the law said free, the city said that cannot be. He went to the temple smithy where the blue stones are set, to learn why; he learned water, but never the stone. Right now he turns the dead grey stone against an enemy. Character: quiet, stubborn and questioning — a man who never got his answer; his shoulders a little bowed, but his arm steady. Pose, the moment of the spell: the camera is low; he stands under a stone arch over a canal, turned toward the right. He has exactly two arms: his near hand holds up toward the right the heavy old bracelet with its dead grey stone, and a cold grey-blue mist pours from it toward the enemy beyond the right edge, draining the colour and strength out of everything it touches; his far hand rests on the stone of the arch. Details that tell his story: (1) the bracelet is thick, old and heavy, its stone a dull grey among bright fittings; (2) a pale band of skin on his wrist; (3) a scarf of worn blue wool wound over his head frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (4) a long coat of a canal worker, wet at the hem; (5) above him, in the keystone of the arch, a blue stone glows bright and alive. Place: a canal of the great white-stone city at night: an arch with a glowing blue keystone, dark water, lamps on the bridges, cypresses on the terraces above. Blue light rises from the water below; green time-sand drifts at his feet.

jobs.title: Габор Помилованный — Безликий, дворф, танк, Земля, донатный сет IV «Снявшие Обод», 4-й (c4-62)
jobs.source: Главы c4-62: «Чужая рука» (рука указывала на него поверх голов; не любит, когда что-то дают), «Праздник сверки» (площадь, книги читают вслух с верхней ступени; тяжесть ушла с запястья — стало тяжелее), «Отработанный подарок» (надел обод сам, чтобы выкупить бригаду из кабального подряда; отработал подарок без платы; сошлось до медяка). Решение агента: держит строй за свою бригаду квадратным железным щитом; молот каменщика; одна медная монета на шнуре — счёт закрыт; борода из тьмы, как у Эйтри (donat-edit.json). К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-62.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Gabor the Pardoned, a dwarf of the great harbor city, one of the Faceless, a defender of the Earth school. Who he is: to buy his work crew out of bonded labour he put the debtor's bracelet on himself — for a dwarf a double shame, a debt and another's hand. At the festival of reckoning the ruler's hand took it off him as a gift, and a dwarf accepts neither debts nor gifts; so he worked for the city without pay for as many years as he had owed, until the account closed to the last copper. Right now he holds the line for his crew. Character: proud, stubborn and honest to the bone — a dwarf who owes nothing; he is short and enormously broad: a barrel chest, a thick short neck, heavy arms. Pose, the moment of the stand: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right, planted like a rock. He has exactly two arms: his near arm drives a heavy square dwarven shield of iron plates forward toward the right, and amber-orange light of the Earth school bursts from the paving stones as a blow lands on it; his far hand grips a heavy mason's hammer low at his side. Details that tell his story: (1) a leather hood, and a thick braided beard bound with iron rings that falls from the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) a pale band of skin on his thick wrist; (3) a worker's leather apron with chisels and a measuring rod; (4) a single copper coin on a cord at his neck — the last one, the account closed; (5) behind him, a square full of people in soft focus and a high stone stair from which ledgers are read aloud. Place: the great square of the harbor city on the festival of reckoning at dusk: garlands, a high stone stair, the white-stone terraces above. Amber light rises from the cracks in the paving below; green time-sand drifts at his feet.

jobs.title: Тэйнэ Прощённая — Безликая, эльфийка, лекарь, Вода, донатный сет IV «Снявшие Обод», 5-я (c4-63)
jobs.source: Главы c4-63: «Гарь в доках» (мокрая гарь над водой; руки тянутся к холодной воде; настои втридорога — брала в долг), «Милость» (мальчик в дорогой постели; лекари отказались; холод на запястье кончился при десяти свидетелях), «К корням» (обод на эльфийском запястье, какого гавань не видела; бледную полосу не прятать). Решение агента: струя прохладной светящейся воды с ладони на обожжённых за правым краем, пар; флакон настоя; кончики эльфийских ушей сквозь шаль, как у Мэлин. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-63.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Teine the Forgiven, an elven woman of the great harbor city, one of the Faceless, a healer of the Water school. Who she is: after a great fire in the docks she healed the burned debtors of the harbor; the tinctures cost three times their worth and were never enough, so she borrowed — and wore the debtor's bracelet on her own elven wrist, such as the harbor had never seen. When she healed the creditor's son, whom every healer had refused, the creditor took the bracelet off her before ten witnesses. She never went back to the forest: the harbor became her forest. Right now she heals the burned with cool water. Character: tender, tireless and fearless — kindness that pays any price; her whole body leans toward the wounded. Pose, the moment of healing: the camera is low; she stands on the smoke-blackened docks, turned toward the right, leaning forward. She has exactly two arms: her near hand is stretched toward the right, and a stream of cool, glowing blue water of the Water school flows from her palm onto the burned beyond the right edge, steam rising where it touches; her far hand holds a small glass vial of tincture. Details that tell her story: (1) a long shawl of sea-green wool drawn over her head frames the smooth darkness where her face should be, and the tips of her long pointed elven ears show through it; (2) a pale band of skin on her slender wrist; (3) a satchel of costly tincture vials, several of them empty; (4) soot on her sleeves and hem; (5) behind her, the charred ribs of burned warehouses and smoke over the water. Place: the burned docks of the harbor city at dawn after the fire: charred beams, drifting smoke, dark water, the white city above. Cool blue light rises from the water below; green time-sand drifts at her feet.
